project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows multi-source ingestion, local filtering, structured outputs and consistency checks, which transfers well to building and evolving reliable data pipelines.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: préparer et structurer les données pour répondre aux besoins analytiques, décisionnels et IA
project_selection_reasons.reason: Adds hybrid retrieval, indexing and evaluation with FAISS and reranking, which supports structured data access, traceability and AI-oriented data preparation.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: déployer, automatiser et superviser les solutions en production en adoptant les meilleures pratiques DevOps et DataOps
project_selection_reasons.reason: Offers an orchestration pattern with LangGraph and Docker-isolated execution, which is relevant to automation and controlled production-style workflows.

warnings: No direct Snowflake, SnowSQL, Snowpipe, dbt/Fivetran/Matillion, Talend/Informatica Cloud/Tibco, GitLab, Jenkins or Terraform evidence is present in the profile; selected skills therefore emphasize transferable data engineering and automation capabilities.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Concevoir, développer et maintenir les flux d'alimentation (ETL ODI ou équivalent) et les modèles de données (datamarts) ;
project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows multi-source ingestion, structured outputs, validation and local persistence; this is transferable to designing reliable data flows and reusable analytical datasets.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Produire des restitutions intelligibles et argumentées à destination des instances de pilotage ;
project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows hybrid retrieval, cited answers and retrieval evaluation; this is transferable to source-backed restitutions and documenting how evidence is selected.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Réaliser des analyses statistiques quantitatives et, le cas échéant, qualitatives sur des jeux de données institutionnels (structurées, quantitatives, textuelles, données non structurées à structurer, etc.) ;
project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows an ongoing pipeline with LoRA fine-tuning, executable calculation graphs and baseline evaluation; this is transferable to structured quantitative analysis and explicit assumption tracking.

warnings: The profile does not contain direct ODI, SAP Business Objects, Crystal Reports or PL/SQL evidence; selected projects emphasize transferable data structuring, evidence-backed reporting and quantitative analysis.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Développer des services backend robustes et des interfaces utilisateur modernes.
project_selection_reasons.reason: Élan shows end-to-end application delivery with structured LLM generation, validation, local persistence and a desktop interface, which maps well to backend services and modern UI work.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Développer des modules innovants intégrant l'intelligence artificielle générative, l'analyse de données ou l'automatisation de processus métiers.
project_selection_reasons.reason: SciFact RAG Verifier directly demonstrates a hybrid RAG pipeline with FAISS indexing, reranking and cited LLM generation for evidence-based retrieval work.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Développer des modules innovants intégrant l'intelligence artificielle générative, l'analyse de données ou l'automatisation de processus métiers.
project_selection_reasons.reason: Pentesting Agent provides narrow evidence of an in-development Planner-Worker LLM agent setup with LangGraph and Docker-isolated targets, useful for process automation and technical investigation.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Le poste s’inscrit dans un environnement Data, avec un enjeu fort autour du fonctionnement, de l’évolution et de l’intégration des différentes briques de la plateforme.
project_selection_reasons.reason: Builds a data-driven application with multi-source ingestion, semantic matching, structured outputs and consistency checks, which transfers to platform work that integrates and maintains multiple components.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Concevoir et développer les nouveaux endpoints et l'API dédiée à Danim, avec le contrat d'interface (documentation, versioning, tests)
project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows service-oriented work around retrieval, API-backed generation and evaluation, useful for designing and maintaining API-facing components and data workflows.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Corriger les failles de sécurité (Snyk, pentests), mettre à jour les dépendances et maintenir les pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI)
project_selection_reasons.reason: Adds hands-on security-testing orchestration in Docker-isolated environments, which is relevant to vulnerability remediation and hardened delivery workflows.

warnings: Offer-specific stack items such as Kotlin, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, GeoJSON, OpenAPI/Swagger, GitLab CI, Snyk, TypeScript, Node.js and Flutter are not available in the candidate skill catalogue; selected skills therefore emphasize adjacent Python, API and data-infra strengths.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Rédiger la documentation fonctionnelle du coefficient d'élasticité pour les équipes métier
project_selection_reasons.reason: Structured generation plus validation and consistency checks make this project useful for controlled, reviewable outputs and functional documentation.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Orchestrer les pipelines avec ZenML en exécution Vertex AI conteneurisée, avec CI qualité
project_selection_reasons.reason: LangGraph-based planning/worker orchestration with Docker isolation shows transferable workflow coordination for containerized execution.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Mettre en place des quality gates (MAPE, WAPE, turnover-weighted WAPE) et des contrôles de performance drift
project_selection_reasons.reason: Hybrid retrieval with explicit metrics, reranking and retriever fine-tuning shows disciplined model evaluation suitable for quality gates and drift checks.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: notamment à travers des solutions d'assistance au développement et au test logiciel
project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows agent orchestration, Docker-isolated execution and verification loops that transfer well to software-development and test assistance; the security-testing domain itself is different.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: L'accompagnement d'entités du Groupe et de partenaires externes, dans les secteurs défense et civil, dans leur transformation numérique par l'IA, notamment à travers des solutions d'assistance au développement et au test logiciel
project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows end-to-end AI application delivery with structured outputs, validation and consistency checks, which is useful for dependable industrial AI tooling and digital-transformation work.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Développer des solutions IA pour des systèmes critiques de défense, en particulier autour du maintien en condition opérationnelle (MCO) naval
project_selection_reasons.reason: Demonstrates a hybrid retrieval-and-generation workflow with cited verdicts and retrieval evaluation, which is a strong transfer to robust AI components in critical-information settings.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: concevoir des agents capables d’orchestrer plusieurs tools et services pour exécuter des tâches métier
project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows a LangGraph-based planner-worker agent architecture that coordinates tool use and verification, which is directly transferable to tool-using LLM agents.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: identifier et développer des cas d’usage d’IA générative applicables aux processus et applications existants
project_selection_reasons.reason: Demonstrates a hybrid RAG pipeline with retrieval, cited generation and evaluation, a practical pattern for building generative AI use cases inside existing applications.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: développer des POC, évaluer leur pertinence puis industrialiser les solutions retenues
project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows structured LLM outputs, validation and workflow automation in a packaged application, which is useful for moving from POC work toward an industrialized solution.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Analyser des logs de vol et participer au diagnostic de systèmes robotiques complexes
project_selection_reasons.reason: Closest evidence for the diagnostic side of the role: the project detects anomalies in heterogeneous logs and prioritizes investigations, which transfers well to analyzing test and flight logs to diagnose robotic systems.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Participer à l’intégration de différentes sources de données issues de capteurs
project_selection_reasons.reason: Relevant for sensor-data integration and perception work: it processes 3D point clouds and aggregates multi-view predictions, which is useful when combining multiple sensor sources in autonomy pipelines.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Mettre en place des outils de simulation, d’expérimentation et de validation
project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows structured internal tooling and a validation workflow with automated consistency checks, which is transferable to simulation, experimentation and validation tooling.

warnings: The profile does not provide direct evidence for GNC-specific C++, Kalman filtering, state estimation or sensor fusion; the selection emphasizes adjacent diagnostics, perception and experimentation strengths.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Concevoir et développer des pipelines de données robustes et scalables sur Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
project_selection_reasons.reason: Multi-source ingestion, structured outputs and consistency checks show end-to-end workflow automation and data-quality control that transfer well to robust pipeline development and delivery support.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Améliorer la performance et la scalabilité des solutions existantes.
project_selection_reasons.reason: Hybrid retrieval, FAISS indexing, reranking and configurable generation show pipeline design, performance tuning and scalable retrieval workflows that transfer well to improving existing data solutions.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Support au déploiement et maintenance corrective ou évolutive.
project_selection_reasons.reason: LangGraph orchestration, Docker-isolated execution and result verification show automated workflow orchestration and deployment-oriented engineering useful for maintenance and rollout tasks.

warnings: No allowed skill entry covers GCP, BigQuery, Dataflow, DataForm, Pub/Sub or CloudComposer, and none of the selected projects directly demonstrates GCP; the CV must lean on transferable pipeline, cloud and deployment skills.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Concevoir et expérimenter des assistants et agents IA capables d'automatiser des tâches d'analyse, de recherche d'information ou de pilotage de la performance.
project_selection_reasons.reason: Strong match for assistants that automate information search: the project builds a hybrid RAG pipeline with cited answers and retrieval evaluation, which transfers to grounded analysis and research workflows.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Concevoir et expérimenter des assistants et agents IA capables d'automatiser des tâches d'analyse, de recherche d'information ou de pilotage de la performance.
project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows LangGraph-based planner-worker orchestration with verification, which is directly relevant to prototyping agent workflows that coordinate analysis steps and checks.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Évaluer la valeur métier des solutions IA, mesurer leur impact et accompagner leur adoption au sein des équipes.
project_selection_reasons.reason: Demonstrates structured LLM outputs, semantic matching and validation in a user-facing workflow, which is useful for assessing whether AI automation is reliable enough for adoption.

warnings: Databricks is requested in the offer but is not present in the allowed skills catalogue, so it cannot be selected.

structured_response.cv_title: Data Scientist — Applied AI & Multimodal ML

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Plateformes IA hybrides et multi-GPU : Concevoir et industrialiser une plateforme capable de gérer l’entraînement distribué de modèles sur plusieurs GPU, avec des enjeux de performance, de scalabilité, de robustesse et de mise en production.
project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows an ongoing model-training research pipeline with LoRA fine-tuning, executable calculation graphs and custom training losses, which is transferable to industrializing distributed model-training workflows.

project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows a retrieval-heavy AI pipeline combining BM25, FAISS and LLM generation with evaluation, which transfers to building scalable AI services and integrating retrieval into production systems.

project_selection_reasons.offer_evidence: Nos équipes conçoivent, modernisent et industrialisent des plateformes et des applications de calcul complexes.
project_selection_reasons.reason: Shows structured LLM generation, consistency checks and a packaged application, which is useful evidence for industrializing robust AI platforms and validating outputs before release.

warnings: No profile project directly covers HPC-specific profiling or cloud migration; the selected projects provide the closest transferable AI engineering evidence.
